title: shared closed-form KV translator basis with pair codes
hypothesis: A low-rank shared basis over calibrated per-head affine KV maps can transfer caches for a heldout source-target model pair with target next-token NLL close to independent full ridge maps and substantially fewer serialized translator bytes.
physical_object: Per-head key/value affine ridge translators for three ordered pairs over cached pretrained Pythia-70M, GPT-2, and SmolLM2-135M models
mirror_coordinate: Rank-r coefficients for each pair/layer/head/key-or-value map, plus deterministic source-layer/head assignments
logical_multiplicity: Multiple ordered cross-model KV translators addressed by pair, layer, head, and KV role

model_pairs.source_target_mapping: Nearest relative-depth source layer and nearest normalized source KV head; fixed before any quality results

controls: full independent per-head affine ridge maps for heldout pair
native PCA basis and per-map code over the same trained map family
source-cache translation with heldout pair full maps

development.selection_metric: Choose the smallest rank with mean heldout next-token NLL delta <= 0.05 nat from full ridge; otherwise freeze the rank with lowest delta. No fresh data used for selection.

fresh.candidate_prompt_constraints: 16-128 tokens; source and target token offset boundaries must match exactly; deterministic disjoint seed partitions
fresh.calibration_selection: Disjoint 12-prompt chunks from Wikitext validation aligned-prompt pool; three seeds partition the 36 selected prompts.

mapping.cache: Hugging Face legacy past_key_values; per target layer/head map source K or V from a deterministic depth/head alignment
mapping.fit: Affine per-head ridge from source 64D cache vector plus intercept to target 64D cache vector; alpha=0.01
mapping.basis: Center all seen-pair flattened affine maps, fit PCA on the two basis-train ordered pairs only, and encode every map with rank-r coefficients
mapping.heldout_pair: Fit full independent ridge maps from heldout-pair calibration prompts; project those maps onto the frozen basis without using heldout test prompts
mapping.text_alignment: Only prompts whose source and target fast-tokenizer character offset sequences are exactly equal are eligible

quality.primary: Target-model next-token NLL on the heldout ordered pair using translated prefix KV and target final-prefix token
quality.secondary: Heldout target KV relative squared error versus target native prefill
quality.gate: Mean heldout NLL delta <= 0.05 nat from independent full ridge in every fresh world; report per-prompt distribution and native target NLL
quality.boundary: Text is Wikitext-2; this is a narrow cache-transfer screen, not general model equivalence

storage.authority: Exact deterministic little-endian float32/int16/uint8 serialized translator payload bytes
paid_objects: independent full ridge matrices in control
report: source/target model weight bytes and tokenizer/config bytes separately
storage.amortization: Charge shared basis once across all 456 per-head K/V maps and task codes for each map
storage.common_state: Source and target model weights are common to all translator controls and are reported but excluded from marginal mapper compression ratio.

report: map construction and PCA wall time
source prefill plus translator plus target suffix wall time
compute.hardware: CPU-only execution; CUDA unavailable. No GPU throughput or latency claim.

success_gate: At a development-selected frozen rank, heldout-pair NLL delta <= 0.05 nat in each fresh world and three-pair family translator bytes are at least 80% below independent full-map bytes. Mirror-specific attribution additionally requires improvement over native PCA map coding at matched rank/bytes/compute.
failure_gate: Any quality/storage gate miss or native PCA exact alias fails the Mirror-specific claim. Preserve cache-transfer quality/byte evidence independently.
boundaries: Only three locally cached pretrained models and one heldout ordered pair are tested.
No GPU available; CPU timing only.
Tokenizer alignment restricts the text sample to prompts with identical token character offsets.
Map alignment uses deterministic relative depth/head matching rather than learned source-layer selection.
The basis is learned from two pairs and does not establish generalization to arbitrary model families or architectures.

protocol_amendments.timing: before model-quality development run and before fresh test prompts were selected
protocol_amendments.change: Tokenizer-offset feasibility scan found only 45 aligned validation prompts for GPT-2→Pythia among 4,358 validation rows. Calibration reduced from 64 to 12 disjoint prompts per fresh world (36 total), retaining 64 disjoint test prompts per world. Calibration still supplies hundreds of token positions per per-head ridge map.

protocol_amendments.timing: before model-quality development run and before fresh test prompts were selected
protocol_amendments.change: Wikitext-2 test has fewer exactly token-offset-aligned prompts than validation for GPT-2→Pythia; test prompt count reduced from 64 to 16 per seed (48 disjoint total), still yielding fresh target-NLL comparisons. No metric values had been inspected.
